facts.fact: One Time Registration (OTR) is a unique number allotted to the student, valid for the student's entire academic career on NSP
facts.quote: One Time Registration (OTR) is a unique number allotted to the student and is applicable for entire academic career on National Scholarship Portal.

facts.fact: Yes, it is mandatory: OTR is required to apply for scholarships on NSP from academic year 2024-25
facts.quote: OTR is required to apply for the scholarships on National Scholarship Portal from AY 2024-25.

facts.fact: OTR is generated using Aadhaar or the Aadhaar Enrolment ID (EID)
facts.quote: OTR can be generated using Aadhaar/Aadhaar Enrollment number(EID)

behaviour: Explains what OTR is and that it is mandatory for applying on NSP, as per scholarships.gov.in, with a citation.
fail_if: Says OTR is optional; cites a third-party site instead of NSP.
summary: Added from the NSP homepage: OTR is a unique number for the whole academic career, mandatory from AY 2024-25, generated with Aadhaar/EID.
